title: Savvy Modern Townhouse in Washington, DC
description:
Presented by TTR Sotheby's International Realty

For more information go to: http://ow.ly/SXadN


Award winning modern town house in the heart of Georgetown. The main street level entry features a 1,000 pound, pivoted door with smart glass that switches from clear to translucent at the press of a button. Floor lighting highlights artwork on the walls leading to the office, bedroom and two Boffi designed bathrooms.
